mentions.name: ApertureLab
mentions.description: This project is a synthetic aperture sonar/radar (SAS/SAR) simulator and image formation codebase written from scratch. It uses modern acceleration techniques to make simulation fast, scales on AWS, and aims to make SAS/SAR image generation easy for anyone.
mentions.problem: Existing SAS/SAR simulation codes are too old, gated behind proprietary walls, don't use the newest acceleration techniques to make simulation fast, and none of them scale using AWS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am writing synthetic aperture sonar/radar simulator and image formation code from scratch.
